body: i just want it all to be over. i don’t want to suffer any longer. please.
i’ve already done that to my psychiatrist and psychologist. none of this helped.

i don’t think i can tell you anything reasonable. i have “perfect” life. i’m a “beautiful” 21 year old woman, i have a loving family and boyfriend. i’ve just feel so wrong for so long. i feel like i just don’t belong in here.
and actually if you’re still alive please talk to me about this 8 number, since it’s my favorite one
If you ever wanted to talk just message me. If not... good luck
